summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited semi-annual report for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report containing financial statements, MD&A, and risk factors, with no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or capital return. The registrant acts solely as a filer of required disclosures under the Securities Exchange Act. No deal terms are present. This is not a special situation; it is an ordinary earnings and financial reporting event.
